links.what: producer result: stored to [rsp+0x110] after call 0x275fee0, loaded into r8 before the creator call
creator compares r8 (5th argument) with the threshold and keeps it in r13 for the cap multiply
other_volume_user applies the same threshold and cap constants
name length: r15 = [name+0x10] is compared with 100 and passed as r8 to name_helper
creator: the volume compare is the first instruction after the prologue
name_helper: the r8 length test is the first instruction after the prologue
handler: prologue, argument moves, then the tracker lea
deriver: prologue, argument moves, then the map guard
both names pass through slot 0x576e050 (0x1344900) before the length compare and bcmp
tracker base: handler passes exchange+0x37e0; the producer reads the same map at exchange+0x37e0
user table: the handler probes exchange+0x740 (ctrl) / +0x758 (items) and later calls 0x1f849b0(exchange+0x740)
sub_account_to_master: probed at tracker+0x30 (items at +0x48) and inserted at tracker+0x30

producer state at rsp+0x20 as the fold reads it: [+0]=1, [+0x8]=&Vec (bucket+0x18), front [+0x10]=0, back [+0x20]=0, once(master) tag 1 at [+0x30]; so the fold steps the master, skips both slice loops and folds the Vec through 0x26b2180
alloc_fail: the pinned window is its whole FDE window and holds no ret instruction
the Vec fold reads the 20-byte address at record+0x18 of 0x40-byte records, as the creator writes it
deriver count = [bucket_end-0x8] (bucket+0x28, the Vec len), the same field the creator's cap compares
deriver passes the count at args+0x30 (rsp+0x98, args = rsi = rsp+0x68); the builder keeps rsi in r15 and loads [r15+0x30] into limb 0
the count is Uint limb 0 (token 2 at +0x50, limb 0 at +0x58 = token+0x8); the word writer stores the limb at token+0x8 byte-swapped at word+0x18, so the count fills word bytes 24..32 big-endian

vec_entry returns X-0x18 on both paths; X is a bucket end on the vacant path, which writes the 20-byte key at X-0x30 and Vec {cap 0, ptr 8, len 0} at X-0x18..-0x8 of a 0x30-byte bucket; on the occupied path X comes from 0x379a4d0 (inference); the creator compares len [ret+0x10] (= X-0x8; on the vacant path bucket_end-0x8, the field the cap and the deriver read) with cap [ret], pushes through ptr [ret+0x8] and stores len+1 to [ret+0x10]

the fold hands the exchange to both callees: rdx (the producer's rbx) is stored at [rsp+0x10]; the step gets ctx = rsp with [rsp] = rsp+0x10 and reads [[ctx]]; the Vec fold gets rdx = rsp+0x8, a copy of [rsp+0x10], and reads [rdx]

the step and the Vec fold walk the same table, [exchange+0x5c8] records of 0x2f0 bytes from [exchange+0x5c0]: the step passes record+0xf8 to 0x36f57f0 and sums [result+0x40]/[result+0x48]; the Vec fold probes the map at record+0xf8 (mask +0x100, items +0x110, hasher +0x118, 0x78-byte buckets) inline and sums [value+0x40]/[value+0x48]; both look the user up at exchange+0x80 through slot 0x5773170

volume_operand.aggregate: step(master) via 0x2773bb0, then 0x26b2180 over the Vec at the master's bucket (address at record+0x18); front/back slice iterators are null in this state
volume_operand.arithmetic: u64 adds checked with jb/jae; on carry the step calls slot 0x5773190 (volume_report, two ret paths) and saturates to 0xffffffffffffffff (cmov)
volume_operand.message: status 0xdd: format args[0] = &100000.0, args[1] = &(status+8) = operand / 100.0; template 'Required: $' marker '. Traded: $' marker (marker-to-argument order assumed)
volume_operand.step: returns acc + (L + R): R = sum over the [exchange+0x5c8] records (0x2f0 bytes from [exchange+0x5c0]) of [0x36f57f0(record+0xf8, &user)+0x40]; L = [lookup(exchange+0x80, &user)+0x0] through slot 0x5773170; the +0x48 / +0x8 parallel sum is only checked
volume_operand.sub_threshold_format: cvtsi2sd r8 only on the < 0x989680 branch, then / 100.0
